status: criteria specified before collection and before independent evaluation
assignment: SHA256('independent-v1:' + cohortID), first 8 hex digits modulo 5: zero holdout, otherwise development. All linked authors/encounters share a cohort. Any exposure promotes the entire cohort to development permanently; never rebalance after observing results.
rationale: Carry forward provisional development floors before seeing human cases, plus strict abstention/ambiguity/confidence contracts. These are screening criteria, not a calibrated accuracy or safety guarantee. Require 30 positives and 10 of each policy class before a pass/fail conclusion; smaller cohorts report descriptive metrics and insufficient sample. The 12-observation pilot checks collection and labelling only.
confidence: Finite relativeMatch strengths within [0,1], limited observations capped at 0.64, ambiguous cases capped at 0.64; not probabilities. Publish numerator/denominator and uncertainty caveats, never 0/0 as a pass.
coverage: Evaluate development pack and real publication subset separately. No approved target or unavailable selected pack is coverage-blocked, not a search failure or successful no-match. Unresolved labels are retained and excluded from quality denominators.
holdoutDisclosure: Only custodian sees wording, identities, case-level ranks/errors and raw logs. Development output receives aggregate numerators/denominators only. Do not enrich or tune from held-out cases; move the entire exposed cohort to development in a new dataset version and retain the old frozen baseline.
independence: Authorship attestation and separate identity verification are required, but software cannot prove human independence. No model-authored examples are accepted as independent data. No collection outreach is authorized by this protocol.
